english_title: Proposition 2.1.3: Zeros of a One-Variable Complex Analytic Function Are Isolated on an Open Connected Set
statement_en: Let $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$ be a nonzero holomorphic function on a nonempty open connected set $U$, and let $z_0\in U$ be a zero of $f$. Then there exists a disk $D(z_0,r)$ such that $z_0$ is the only zero of $f$ in that disk.
key_techniques: factorization by the order of vanishing
callout_body: $f:U\to\mathbb{C}$是定义在非空开连通子集$U$上的**非零**全纯函数，并且$z_0\in U$是其一个零点，那么存在一个圆盘$D(z_0,r)$使得函数在圆盘里面，除了$z_0$以外没有任何其他零点。
